( #{r.equipmentId}, #{r.bucketStart}, #{r.workOrderId}, #{r.sampleCount}, #{r.temperatureSum}, #{r.temperatureCount}, #{r.temperatureMin, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.temperatureMax, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.vibrationSum}, #{r.vibrationCount}, #{r.vibrationMin, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.vibrationMax, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.runSec}, #{r.warnSec}, #{r.downSec}, #{r.idleSec}, #{r.lastStatus}, #{r.lastRecordedAt}, #{r.lastTemperature, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.lastVibration, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
ON CONFLICT (equipment_id, bucket_start, work_order_id) DO UPDATE SET
mapper.insert: sample_count = t.sample_count + EXCLUDED.sample_count, temperature_sum = t.temperature_sum + EXCLUDED.temperature_sum, temperature_count = t.temperature_count + EXCLUDED.temperature_count, temperature_min = LEAST(t.temperature_min, EXCLUDED.temperature_min), temperature_max = GREATEST(t.temperature_max, EXCLUDED.temperature_max), vibration_sum = t.vibration_sum + EXCLUDED.vibration_sum, vibration_count = t.vibration_count + EXCLUDED.vibration_count, vibration_min = LEAST(t.vibration_min, EXCLUDED.vibration_min), vibration_max = GREATEST(t.vibration_max, EXCLUDED.vibration_max), run_sec = t.run_sec + EXCLUDED.run_sec, warn_sec = t.warn_sec + EXCLUDED.warn_sec, down_sec = t.down_sec + EXCLUDED.down_sec, idle_sec = t.idle_sec + EXCLUDED.idle_sec, last_status = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_recorded_at >= t.last_recorded_at THEN EXCLUDED.last_status ELSE t.last_status END, last_temperature = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_recorded_at >= t.last_recorded_at THEN EXCLUDED.last_temperature ELSE t.last_temperature END, last_vibration = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_recorded_at >= t.last_recorded_at THEN EXCLUDED.last_vibration ELSE t.last_vibration END, last_recorded_at = GREATEST(t.last_recorded_at, EXCLUDED.last_recorded_at)

sample_count = EXCLUDED.sample_count, temperature_sum = EXCLUDED.temperature_sum, temperature_count = EXCLUDED.temperature_count, temperature_min = EXCLUDED.temperature_min, temperature_max = EXCLUDED.temperature_max, vibration_sum = EXCLUDED.vibration_sum, vibration_count = EXCLUDED.vibration_count, vibration_min = EXCLUDED.vibration_min, vibration_max = EXCLUDED.vibration_max, run_sec = EXCLUDED.run_sec, warn_sec = EXCLUDED.warn_sec, down_sec = EXCLUDED.down_sec, idle_sec = EXCLUDED.idle_sec, last_status = EXCLUDED.last_status, last_recorded_at = EXCLUDED.last_recorded_at, last_temperature = EXCLUDED.last_temperature, last_vibration = EXCLUDED.last_vibration
mapper.select:
SELECT equipment_id AS "equipmentId",
date_bin(#{bucketSec} * INTERVAL '1 second', bucket_start, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01 00:00:00+09') AS "bucketStart",
sum(sample_count) AS "plannedSec", sum(run_sec + warn_sec) AS "runSec", sum(down_sec) AS "downSec", sum(idle_sec) AS "idleSec" FROM equipment_sensor_minute
WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND bucket_start >= (SELECT date_trunc('minute', started_at) - INTERVAL '1 minute' FROM work_order WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId}) AND bucket_start <= (SELECT COALESCE(completed_at, now()) + INTERVAL '1 minute' FROM work_order WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId})
WHERE work_order_id <> '' AND bucket_start >= date_trunc('minute', #{from}::timestamptz) AND bucket_start < #{to}
GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT equipment_id AS "equipmentId", sum(run_sec) AS "runSec", sum(warn_sec) AS "warnSec", sum(down_sec) AS "downSec", sum(idle_sec) AS "idleSec" FROM equipment_sensor_minute WHERE bucket_start >= date_trunc('minute', #{from}::timestamptz) GROUP BY equipment_id

SELECT bucket_start AS "recordedAt", (array_agg(last_status ORDER BY last_recorded_at DESC))[1] AS "status", round(sum(temperature_sum) / NULLIF(sum(temperature_count), 0), 2) AS "temperature", round(sum(vibration_sum) / NULLIF(sum(vibration_count), 0), 2) AS "vibration" FROM equipment_sensor_minute WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND bucket_start >= date_trunc('minute', #{from}::timestamptz) GROUP BY bucket_start ORDER BY bucket_start

SELECT e.equipment_id AS "equipmentId", m.last_recorded_at AS "recordedAt", m.last_status AS "status", m.last_temperature AS "temperature", m.last_vibration AS "vibration" FROM equipment e CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT last_recorded_at, last_status, last_temperature, last_vibration FROM equipment_sensor_minute s WHERE s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id ORDER BY s.bucket_start DESC, s.last_recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) m ORDER BY e.equipment_id
SELECT last_recorded_at FROM equipment_sensor_minute WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY bucket_start DESC, last_recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
